reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Puerto Rico
    Focus year: 2021 (statute text provided is 2020)
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (question facts)
   ========================= */

state(puerto_rico).
focus_year(2021).

% The user asks about the meaning/usage of a term.
asked_term(writ_for_removal).

% The concept the user describes: "the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant".
described_concept(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement is present.
scenario_statement :-
    asked_term(writ_for_removal),
    described_concept(order_from_court_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

/* ==========================================
   Statute translation: PR Laws tit. 1,  51.3
   (Modeled as deterministic legal predicates)
   ========================================== */

% ---  51.3(a): When an order/judgment disposes transfer of possession, the party in whose favor
% it is recorded has a right to a "mandamiento de ejecución" upon request to the clerk/secretary.
% We model the legal instrument as the atom writ_of_execution (mandamiento_de_ejecucion).

% statute_term_used_in_text(+TermAtom)
% Captures which named instruments/terms are explicitly used in the statute text provided.
statute_term_used_in_text(mandamiento_de_ejecucion).
statute_term_used_in_text(mandamiento_de_embargo).
statute_term_used_in_text(auto_entrega_fisica_de_posesion).

% legal_instrument_for_transfer_of_possession(+Instrument)
% Encodes that the statute provides a particular instrument for possession transfer enforcement.
legal_instrument_for_transfer_of_possession(writ_of_execution) :-
    % This corresponds to "mandamiento de ejecución" in  51.3(a).
    statute_term_used_in_text(mandamiento_de_ejecucion),
    !.

% instrument_directs_authority_action(+Instrument, +Action)
% Encodes that the instrument is directed to an officer (e.g., sheriff) to carry out an action.
instrument_directs_authority_action(writ_of_execution, deliver_possession) :-
    legal_instrument_for_transfer_of_possession(writ_of_execution),
    !.

% removal_of_occupant_is_implied_by_deliver_possession(+Boolean)
% A very narrow logical bridge: delivering possession necessarily implies removing occupants if needed.
% (We keep it generic and only use it for mapping "remove tenant" to "deliver possession".)
removal_of_occupant_is_implied_by_deliver_possession(yes) :- !.

% statute_provides_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant(+Instrument)
% True if the statute provides an order/instrument that amounts to directing authorities to remove
% a tenant (conceptually) through delivering possession.
statute_provides_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant(writ_of_execution) :-
    instrument_directs_authority_action(writ_of_execution, deliver_possession),
    removal_of_occupant_is_implied_by_deliver_possession(yes),
    !.

% term_is_used_by_statute_for_that_concept(+AskedTerm)
% The question is about whether the specific term is used to refer to that kind of court order.
% We treat "used" as "appears as a named term in the statute text (or an explicit synonym mapping)".
%
% No synonym mapping is provided in the statute text between "writ for removal" and "mandamiento de ejecución".
term_is_used_by_statute_for_that_concept(AskedTerm) :-
    nonvar(AskedTerm),
    % The statute does provide an instrument for transfer of possession (writ_of_execution),
    statute_provides_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant(writ_of_execution),
    % but the asked term must be one of the terms explicitly used in the statute text.
    AskedTerm == mandamiento_de_ejecucion,
    statute_term_used_in_text(mandamiento_de_ejecucion),
    !.
term_is_used_by_statute_for_that_concept(_AskedTerm) :-
    % Default: not used (deterministic).
    !,
    fail.

/* =========================
   Reasoning and final answer
   ========================= */

% housing_answer(-Result)
% Result must be the atom yes or no, derived from the statute model + scenario facts.
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    asked_term(Term),
    term_is_used_by_statute_for_that_concept(Term),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Writ for removal' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
